0022600032.text: The Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West, on a two-game winning streak) host the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with Los Angeles 4-1 at home and Portland 5-0 on the road. Los Angeles trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 136-129 loss in Los Angeles on October 27, and lost its 2025-26 season series 1-2 to Portland. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle).
